title: S12T06 - Add file lock heartbeat or long operation stale-lock guard
description: The file lock has stale recovery based on createdAt, but no heartbeat or pid-liveness guard for legitimate long operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-running valid operations refresh lock freshness or are protected by pid/owner checks before stale break.
Lock inspection exposes last heartbeat or equivalent freshness metadata, and tests cover active long locks versus truly stale locks.
closedReason: File lock heartbeat guard implemented and verified
